blocks.source_text: I DIDN'T GET MY REFUND YET! ARE YOU SURE YOU SENT IT BACK?! HUH?!
blocks.translation: Tôi vẫn chưa nhận được tiền hoàn lại! Anh chắc là đã gửi trả rồi chứ?! Hả?!

blocks.source_text: WHY IS SHE TELLING ME TO RETURN SOMETHING SHE BOUGHT...? DOES SHE NOT HAVE HANDS? OR FEET?
blocks.translation: Sao cô ta lại bắt mình trả món đồ cô ta mua chứ...? Cô ta không có tay à? Hay không có chân?

blocks.source_text: IF YOU'RE NOT GOING TO USE THEM, DO YOU WANT ME TO GET RID OF THEM FOR GOOD?
blocks.translation: Nếu không định dùng chúng thì có muốn tôi xử luôn cho khỏi cần nữa không?
blocks.notes: Speaker/reference of 'them' is visually ambiguous in the smoke page; translation preserves the threat without inventing the referent.

blocks.source_text: WHAT'S WITH THAT LOOK?! YOU WANT ME TO PLUCK THOSE EYES OUT?
blocks.translation: Cái ánh mắt đó là sao hả?! Muốn tôi móc hai con mắt ấy ra không?

blocks.notes: Stylized visual effect associated with the intense stare; localized semantically rather than phonetically.
